guard: a manager-spawned seat hands no connection material to the processes it spawns, and still resolves its own identity and control token from the launch-material file
why: THE SUITE MAKES TWO OPPOSITE CLAIMS AND EACH NEEDS ITS OWN KILL. It asserts an ABSENCE (no
credential, broker URL or control token in the seat's environment) and a PRESENCE (the seat can
still resolve all three from the launch material). An absence assertion alone passes on a
completely broken seat: a connector that exported nothing at all would sail through it while
being unable to connect to anything. So M1/M2 break the absence and M3 breaks the presence, and
the two families must redden different named assertions or the suite is only half proven.
M1 IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST, because it is killed by observing a REAL PROCESS TREE rather
than by reading the object the assertion was written against. A2 starts a real node process with
the connector's env and has THAT process start a child with no env argument, which is exactly
what a coding agent's shell tool does. What the child reports is what the operating system
actually inherited. A1 covers the same ground by reading the launch spec, and would also catch
M1 - which is why A2 runs FIRST in the suite, so the assertion that watched a real process is
the one that reddens.
EVERY MUTATION BUILDS FIRST, and that is not ceremony. `@cotal-ai/core` and
`@cotal-ai/connector-core` resolve to `dist/`, so a mutation to `src` that is not compiled is a
mutation the suite never sees: the run would be green and the verdict would be a lie in the
reassuring direction. `afterRestore` rebuilds, because `dist/` is gitignored and git cannot be
the recovery for a tree left holding a build compiled from the mutant.
NO `completionMarker` IS DECLARED, and that is deliberate. This suite is fail-fast: it exits at
the first assertion, so its `seat-env-scope: PASS` banner is by construction the one line a
killed run never reaches. Declaring it as the marker graded all three genuine kills
INCONCLUSIVE - the tool's own header warns about exactly this, and it was measured here before
it was believed. A fail-fast suite with no line common to both outcomes declares none.
M4 IS THE OTHER DIRECTION OF THE SAME MISTAKE. M3 removes material and asks whether the suite
notices the seat can no longer reach its broker. M4 leaves the material carrier in place and
removes the READER's refusal of a file that says nothing, which is how a launch that references
material and supplies none resolved to open mode without a word. A write-side guard cannot cover
it: the reader is handed a path by an environment variable and never sees the writer.
M5/M6/M7 COVER THE THREE REFUSALS ADDED AFTER REVIEW, and each one restores a real prior state of
this branch rather than an invented one. M5 drops COTAL_LINK back out of the two-carrier list: a
join link carries server, auth and space in one string, and off the list it did not conflict, it
lost quietly to material precedence. M6 restores the half-pair `undefined`, which left the policy
to five callers that did not agree and let a session run believing it had a control plane it did
not have. M7 restores a scrub that drops the pointer without unlinking, which is the difference
between material that is unreferenced and material that is gone.

mutations.name: M1 the pi connector puts the broker URL back into the seat environment
mutations.replace:
if (opts.configPath) env.COTAL_AGENT_FILE = opts.configPath;
    if (opts.servers) env.COTAL_SERVERS = opts.servers;
mutations.expectRed: A2: a real grandchild of a seat inherited COTAL_SERVERS
mutations.note: Also reds A1 for pi, later in the run. A2 is named because it is the assertion that observed a real descendant process rather than the launch spec.

mutations.name: M2 the claude connector puts the control token back into the seat environment
mutations.expectRed: A1: the claude connector exports COTAL_CONTROL_TOKEN into the seat environment
mutations.note: The control token is the half a build script has least business holding. Claude is the connector that cannot drop the material reference after startup, so its env is the one worth pinning explicitly.

mutations.name: M3 the launch material silently loses the broker URL
mutations.expectRed: A3: claude lost the broker URL
mutations.note: The failure the absence assertions cannot see: material removed from the environment and not delivered anywhere else. Without this kill, a connector that exported nothing would read as fixed.

mutations.name: M4 the reader accepts a material file that says nothing
mutations.expectRed: A6: an empty material object was read as a valid launch instead of refused
mutations.note: The write-side refusal survives this mutation untouched, which is the point: it is the READ side that a broken or truncated file reaches, and without this check `{}` resolved to the default broker with no credential - open mode, silently, on a launch that asked for the opposite.

mutations.name: M5 a join link stops counting as a direct carrier
mutations.expectRed: A7: a launch carrying both a material file and a join link resolved by precedence instead of refusing
mutations.note: The silent half of the two-carrier defect: no error, no warning, just one of two answers to 'who is this session' winning on precedence.

mutations.name: M6 half a control pair reads as no control plane instead of throwing
mutations.find:
if (path && token) return { path, token };
  if (!path && !token) return undefined;
mutations.replace:
if (path && token) return { path, token };
  if (true) return undefined;
mutations.expectRed: A8: a socket with no resolvable token was reported as no control plane rather than a broken one
mutations.note: Exactly the shape that shipped: a broken control endpoint indistinguishable from a session that never had one. The pi launch failure this branch hit live was the loud version of it; the quiet version is a seat whose presence never advances.

mutations.name: M7 the scrub drops the pointer but leaves the file on disk
mutations.expectRed: A5: the material file survived the scrub that was supposed to unlink it
mutations.note: The residual this carrier is honest about is same-uid access to a file that EXISTS. Where there is provably no later reader, the file not existing is the one part of that boundary that can actually be closed, so the closing has to be tested rather than intended.
